row:
Hey there, I'm Mike, your sports massage therapist based in Reading, UK. With a background in sports and massage therapy, I've dedicated myself to helping athletes and active individuals recover, perform, and excel.

💼 About Zeers Therapy:
I'm also the founder of Zeers Therapy, a wellness company focused on promoting peak performance and total body wellness. Through Zeers Therapy, I've expanded my reach and helped countless individuals achieve their health and fitness goals.

📍 Clinics:
You can find us in Berkshire Wokingham. Whether you're recovering from an injury or preparing for a big event, my team and I are here to support you every step of the way.

🎥 What to Expect:
On this channel, you'll find a variety of resources, tips, and insights into sports massage and holistic wellness. From treatments tutorials on self-massage techniques to expert interviews, there's something here for everyone looking to prioritize their health and well-being.
